notes.title: Polish translation added
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I’m writing a post to let you know that my free horror VN, Lynne, has been translated into Polish by Ciara! I’m very happy, as it means even more people can enjoy this story!

As always, please feel free to leave a comment if you see any typos or anything else strange, and I will try to fix it in a reasonable time frame.

Thank you very much for all of your support over the years. It’s appreciated!

- ebi x

notes.title: French Translation
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!

Just writing a post to let you know that Lynne has been updated. The game now features a full French translation!

This translation shouldn't interfere with any old saves made, as I didn't have to make any large changes to the code, so your old saves should work fine.

As always, please let me know if you encounter any problems with the new build, or if you find any typos!
Thank you very much, and I hope you enjoy Lynne!

- ebi x

notes.title: German translation
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!

Just writing a quick post to let you know that Lynne has been updated. The game now features a full German translation, which is very exciting!

I also fixed a handful of typos in the English script, and made some small tweaks to the UI to make the game look a bit prettier.

Please note: I had to make some substantial changes to the script to accommodate these changes, which will break old saves made before this update. If you’ve read through the story once, and you want to read through it again, you’ll have to start a brand new game. I’m sorry for the inconvenience.

Enjoy!

- ebi x

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Just to let you know, I've recently updated this game!
Now, this VN can be played in Brazilian Portuguese. Thank you to VNX + and everybody else who helped to make this possible!
I also fixed a handful of typos in the base English script. Hopefully, the story should be free of any errors now.

If you find anything else that doesn't look right, or you run into any errors, please let me know!

- ebi x
